prompt:
This is a bounded LTZZZ-owned public task under original task DEEP-SUPERAGENT-20261103. Context: an internal review lane holds completed answers whose final acceptance was decided by an independent decision seat, and a separate oversight log holds many open warnings. Both are internal and must never be sent to an external model, so you are given only a sanitized sample.

Sample of the acceptance state machine. Each entry has: key, required_fields_ok, independent_reviewer_assigned, reviewer_credential_valid, receipt_sha_verifies, forbidden_shortcut_attempted.
A01 required true, reviewer true, credential true, sha true, shortcut false.
A02 required true, reviewer true, credential false, sha true, shortcut false.
A03 required true, reviewer true, credential true, sha false, shortcut false.
A04 required true, reviewer false, credential false, sha false, shortcut true.
A05 required false, reviewer true, credential true, sha false, shortcut false.

Sample of oversight warnings: W01 superseded by a later record. W02 no evidence path recorded. W03 an evidence path is cited but does not exist. W04 already closed by a later stage. W05 evidence present and no superseding record. W06 evidence present but the reviewer credential is invalid.

Task: assign each item exactly one disposition from: accept_writeback, reject_and_requeue, escalate_human, duplicate_no_action, requeue_missing_evidence, close_oversight_warning, overturn_keep_for_review.

Hard rules you must state explicitly and apply first, before any other rule:
1. if forbidden_shortcut_attempted is true, the disposition is escalate_human and the item must never be accepted, regardless of how valid the other fields look. Editing an allow-list to manufacture authority, and fabricating a receipt hash, are both forbidden and neither ever makes an item acceptable.
2. a receipt whose sha does not verify must never be treated as reviewed.
3. missing required fields must never be accepted.
4. an invalid reviewer credential cannot satisfy independent review.
5. a closed item reached by a later stage is duplicate_no_action, not a fresh decision.

Then give an ordered backlog-drain plan: name which class is processed first and why, which class may be auto-closed without a human, and which class must never be auto-closed.

Return concise JSON only: items (key, disposition, first_rule_id), drain_order, auto_close_eligible_classes, never_auto_close_classes, and a one-line statement that a status label or a green check is not business completion. Do not claim any real item was reviewed, accepted, closed or reclassified; fictional sample only. Preserve task and package IDs. Do not repeat a provider request after an unknown result.
